title: SupervisionRequest v1
description: What a Supervision agent is given. AGENT_CONTRACTS section 7.5. It receives artifact REFS rather than artifacts, because section 2.3 forbids a supervisor from reviewing the executor's summary: it must reload the actual rows through read tools. That is why there is no field here carrying another agent's output.

rulesetVersion.description: Which ruleset revision to apply. It is recorded with the report so a finding can be read against the rules that produced it.

artifactRefs.description: What to review, by reference. The supervisor reloads these itself.

requiredChecks.description: Rule identifiers the quality gate requires. AGENT_CONTRACTS section 10.1 configures supervision per stage, and the runtime passes the resulting list here so the gate's configuration is not left to the model's judgement.
